Context: 21. Ex gratia Pension/Family Pension to CPF Retirees

The widows and dependent children of the deceased CPF beneficiaries who had retired from service prior to 1-1-1986 are eligible for the grant of ex gratia family pension. In the case of widow /widower, it is payable till death or remarriage, whichever is earlier. In the case of dependent son, it is payable till he attains the age of 25 years or gets employed, whichever is earlier.
